title: Geometric irreducible component counts commute with arbitrary base change
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For $t\in Y$ let $X_t$ be its scheme-theoretic fibre over the residue field $\kappa(t)$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-weil-residue-field]. For any separably closed field extension $K/\kappa(t)$ [def-pc-field-extension, def-pc-separably-closed], let $n_{X/Y}(t)$ be the number of irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $X_t\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)}\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-affine-spectrum], with value $\infty$ if there are infinitely many. This value is independent of the separably closed extension $K$. If $g:Y^\prime\to Y$ is any scheme morphism and $X^\prime=X\times_Y Y^\prime$, then $n_{X^\prime/Y^\prime}(t^\prime)=n_{X/Y}(g(t^\prime))$ for every $t^\prime\in Y^\prime$. No finite type, flatness or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.
